purpose: 256 authored teaching exchanges with three phrasing frames per skill, not general conversation training.
training_policy: Only the train split is optimizer input, following explicit approval of exact file SHA256. Frame 3 of each skill is reserved for held-out wording and never trains. No runtime templates or answer lookup. Test never constructs vocabulary or selects models.
